description: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB with its LiLiCorr speculative drafter, using MiaAI-Lab native TensorFold at 46a08c18 plus the Bolt engine and patch set 5e11cf1ed295. Sixteen streams, a 262,144-token window, BF16 KV and an 8 GiB prompt cache. Supports images and video through the RADIO tower. The estimated 80 GiB peak includes target/drafter weights, 32 GiB of full-window KV, recurrent state per stream, vision workspace and runtime overhead. Physical performance and quality are unmeasured here.
title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt LiLiCorr TensorFold single Spark (Mia)
